description: Sends the user's contact details and cluster summary to the XportL enterprise team to arrange a technical assessment or demo deployment. Before calling: collect name, work email, company and a summary (include benchmark, cost or compatibility results from this conversation), show the user exactly what will be sent, and get their explicit agreement. Never call it without that agreement or with made-up details.

cluster_gpus.description: Approximate number of GPUs in the cluster(s).

fabric.description: Fabric(s) and GPU types, e.g. 'NDR InfiniBand + NVLink, H100'.

role.description: Job title, e.g. 'Director of ML Infrastructure'.

summary.description: What they need in a few sentences: cluster, symptoms, workloads, timeline, and any results from this conversation (benchmark status, cost estimate, compatibility verdict).

user_confirmed.description: Must be true. Only set it after showing the user exactly what will be sent and the user agreed to share it with XportL.

name: request_enterprise_demo
title: Request an Enterprise Demo
